name: 奥迪莉亚·伊利亚
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:194
who: Odilia Ilya, a human priestess-physician of the White Candle order at the southern wall, forty-five in 590: about 172 cm, tall, thin and straight-backed from standing all day in a gate passage. Pale gold hair pinned up at the back of her head, the temples gone white early. A narrow face with high cheekbones and thin lips that look angry when she is not smiling; when she smiles the lines at the corners of her eyes all appear at once. Gold eyes, narrowed from years of looking at wounds. The backs of both hands are covered in layers of old candle-wax burn scars from twenty years of night vigils; she never hides them. On a thin chain at her neck hangs a small bronze tag sealed with white wax and stamped with the candle mark of the southern White Candle hall. A cool, level, stern-kind air; her hand is always cold.
face: FACE, as in the references: the face of a woman of about forty-five, NOT young: narrow, with high cheekbones, thin level lips, fine lines at the corners of the narrowed gold eyes and faint lines beside the mouth, straight pale-gold brows with a few white hairs. Pale clean skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: 172 cm, tall and thin, straight-backed: a modest B-cup, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: washed white and ash grey, pale gold, candle-wax cream, a little bronze
casual: Her White Candle robe: a plain white robe washed to a dull grey, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, the collar open at the throat; a white cord belt with a small leather pouch hung from it holding a few candle stubs, a small knife and a roll of bandage cloth; the wax-sealed bronze tag on its thin chain. She carries no weapon and no blade of any kind. She stands very upright with her hands open and a little forward, a stern, steady look.
private: Off duty in the White Candle hall: a long-sleeved undyed wool dress to the shins, a grey wool shawl, the sleeves pushed up, the pale gold hair let down to the shoulders from its pins, soft shoes. She holds a cup of hot water in both hands and looks at the steam, a tired, quiet look with the faintest smile at the eye corners.
battle: Standing between two lines in a gate passage: the grey-washed white robe belted tight with the white cord, the sleeves rolled, a grey wool cloak pinned at the throat; no blade, no armour. She holds her right hand out flat and open, palm forward, as if asking everyone to stop, and a lit white candle stub in her left hand held at chest height; a stern, unafraid look.
battle_pose: 3) the gate-passage outfit: standing square in the middle of a narrow stone passage, the back straight, the right hand held out flat and open, the left holding a lit white candle stub at chest height; a stern, unafraid look; she carries no weapon.
formal: At a White Candle rite: a full-length white robe with a narrow pale-gold border at the hem, cuffs and collar, a white stole over the shoulders with a single white candle embroidered on the left chest, the white cord belt, the wax-sealed bronze tag. She stands very upright with her scarred hands folded in front, a grave, calm look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the gold eyes narrowed in a stern, kind look, one cool pale hand with its wax scars reaching toward the viewer as if to rest on their forehead. Warm candlelight from one side, the other side in cool grey stone shadow. Foreground blur: a single white candle flame and a thin drip of wax. She wears the washed white robe with the sleeves rolled.

name: 哈诺
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:250
who: Hano, a bone-white demon-kin man of the Baihai folk, who has kept the names at a wall city's gate for four hundred and seventy years and looks twenty-seven or twenty-eight: about 181 cm, tall, lean and light-framed, a build close to a human's. Pale skin, and the knuckles, collarbones and brow ridges are bone-white and gleam faintly. Grey-white eyes that stay wide open even at night. Pale ash-grey hair grown long and tied at the back of his neck with a leather cord. The little finger of his left hand is crooked, set by himself when he was eight and never straightened. On his left wrist a small brass bell is tied on a cord. A quiet, watchful, unsleeping air; he remembers everything.
build: 181 cm, tall and lean, light-boned: a narrow back and long arms, still on his feet through a whole night.
palette: rain grey and bone white, slate grey, charcoal, faded brass
casual: His Grey Rain City gear: an old grey rain-city cloak washed almost white, pinned at the throat, over a plain undyed linen shirt with the collar open and dark trousers; on his left wrist, tied by a cord, a small brass bell of the Long-Axle family; two leather pouches on his belt, one for blank notebooks and charcoal sticks. In his right hand a worn notebook held open, a charcoal stick in the fingers of the same hand, the crooked little finger of the left hand showing. A calm, attentive look.
private: Sitting by a gate-fire at night with the cloak off: a plain undyed linen shirt with the sleeves turned back, the collar open, dark trousers, the hair loosened from its cord. He leafs through a worn old notebook on his knee, the small brass bell on his left wrist, a quiet, absorbed look.
battle: Standing his ground at a gate passage: the washed-out grey cloak pinned tight, the pouches buckled shut, sturdy dark boots; he carries no weapon. He holds up an open notebook in his left hand and a charcoal stick in his right as if about to write a name, a level, unflinching look.
battle_pose: 3) the gate-passage outfit: standing very still and upright, the open notebook raised in one hand and the charcoal stick held ready in the other, the grey eyes wide open and level; he does not fight.
formal: At a day of names at the gate of Grey Rain City: a long clean dark grey wool coat of the western cut with a stand collar fastened to the throat by plain bone buttons, a narrow band of white thread at the cuffs, the washed-pale grey rain cloak folded over his arm and held by an iron pin, the small brass bell on his left wrist. A few ink-pale name runes in the cuff thread glow faintly when he moves. He stands upright with the notebook closed against his chest, a quiet, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the grey-white eyes wide open and unblinking, looking straight at the viewer as if waiting for a name. Cold blue gate-passage light from one side, a warm lamp glow far behind. Foreground blur: the corner of an open notebook, a charcoal stick and drifting rain. He wears the washed grey cloak.

name: 吉塞拉·富尔曼
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:306
who: Gisela Fuhrmann, a human wall-town clerk of the southern stretch, twenty-four: about 163 cm, medium height, round-faced and sturdy, able to sit all day at a desk and still drive a wagon. Cherry-pink hair braided into one thick plait coiled at the back of her head with a charcoal pen stuck in it. Lake-blue eyes that narrow when she reads and go wide when she looks at a person. A thick callus on the right middle finger from the pen, and ink under her nails. Round, soft cheeks. Around her neck on a cord a brass coachman's whistle, her father's. A brisk, careful, exact air; she reads out names so plainly that even the storks stop clattering.
build: 163 cm, round and sturdy: a full C-cup, a soft waist and rounded hips.
palette: cherry pink and lake blue, wall-town grey, ink black, a little brass
casual: Her clerk's clothes: a grey wool wall-town coat with patches sewn on the cuffs, over an old plain cotton dress; at her belt a leather case holding a bottle of ink, two pens and a scraping knife; her father's brass coachman's whistle hung on a cord at her neck. She holds a thick open register against her chest with one arm, a pen in the other hand, a careful, bright look.
private: In the clerks' room after the lamps are lit: a plain long-sleeved cotton dress with ink-stained cuffs, a grey shawl, the braid taken down and hanging over one shoulder, soft shoes. She holds a mug of hot tea in both hands, the pen tucked behind her ear, a relaxed look.
battle: Reading out names at the gate-tower: the patched grey coat buttoned up, sleeves pushed to the elbow, the leather case at her belt, sturdy boots. She holds a thick open register in her left hand and raises her right arm with a finger pointing along a line of names; she carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the gate-tower outfit: standing square and brisk, the chin lifted, the thick register held open in one hand, the other hand holding a pen raised to tick a name; a firm, clear look; she does not fight.
formal: For the day the registers are read before the wall-town council: a clean grey wall-town wool coat with a turned-down collar worn open over a white linen shirt, a plain cord tie, a brushed cuff with a stitched patch, the leather ink case at her belt. A thin line of silver thread along the lapel faintly lights when she reads aloud. The braid is re-coiled with a fresh pen in it, the brass whistle tucked inside the shirt. She stands very upright with the closed register against her chest, a composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the lake-blue eyes wide open as she looks straight at the viewer, about to read out a name, the lips parted only enough to speak, no smile. Cool daylight from a high window on one side. Foreground blur: the edge of a thick register page covered in neat names and a drop of ink on a pen nib. She wears the patched grey coat.

name: 琉妲
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:362
who: Ludda, a night-blood demon-kin woman of the Feast bloodline, a field herbalist and healer of a camp beyond the wall, forty-five in 590 and looking about thirty: about 170 cm, tall and thin, long-fingered. Dark red hair cut level at the ears, and two small curved horns on the forehead with black tips. Pale skin and dark lips. Dark red eyes that glow at night. On the inside of her left wrist (on the viewer's right when she faces us) seven thin scars lie in a neat row. Her nails are cut very short. A sharp-tongued, steady-handed, soft-hearted air, which she hides; her hands are cold.
build: 170 cm, tall and thin, long-fingered: a modest B-cup, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: dark red and charcoal grey, bone white, washed grey cloth, a little old iron
casual: Her healer's clothes: a grey cloth robe washed thin, buttoned to the throat, one cuff torn off to make a bandage; an empty herb satchel at her belt; a leather cord at her neck with a small knife of polished bone hanging from it. She holds a roll of bandage cloth in one hand, the other hand open, a sharp, watchful look.
private: Resting in the camp after the sick are asleep: a loose long-sleeved dark grey wool dress buttoned to the collar, the sleeves pushed up so the row of seven scars shows on her left wrist, soft shoes, the dark red hair tousled. She is grinding dried leaves in a small stone bowl, a tired, dry look.
battle: Working in a field aid tent: the grey robe belted tight, a dark apron over it, the sleeves tied back, the herb satchel and bone knife at her waist. She kneels on one knee holding the small bone knife in her right hand over a roll of bandage in her left; she carries no other weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the aid-tent outfit: crouched on one knee, steady and focused, the small bone knife held ready in one hand and a roll of bandage cloth in the other, the dark red eyes lowered to a wound she is about to treat; she does not fight.
formal: For a meeting of the healers beyond the wall: a washed grey cloth robe of the western cut buttoned to the throat with bone buttons, a dark red sash knotted at the waist with a small herb sprig pinned in it, the empty cuff neatly hemmed, a thin band of dark red rune-thread around the collar that glows like an ember. The bone knife stays inside the robe. She stands very upright with her hands folded, a dry, composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the dark red eyes glowing faintly as they look straight at the viewer, a dry, exact look as she sizes up where it hurts; one long cold hand with the seven scars on the wrist raised near her chin. Dim lamp light from one side. Foreground blur: a curl of bandage cloth and drifting dried herb leaves. She wears the grey robe.

name: 博鲁
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:519
who: Boru, a Thunder-Gaol demon-kin blacksmith with a brand on his neck, a forward of the sluice-mouth wall post, forty-six in 607: about 238 cm, two heads taller than an ordinary man, with shoulders and back like a door and a heavy frame. Deep bronze skin that looks like heated iron. Two ox horns curving outward, the tip of the left horn chipped (on the viewer's right when he faces us). A wide face with a square jaw; very pale grey eyes; short cropped dull copper-brown hair. On the back of his neck the brand is a patch of shiny iron-coloured skin rather than a scar. His huge hands are covered in old burn scars. He lowers his head a little before he looks at anyone. A slow, heavy, steady air.
build: 238 cm, towering and heavy-boned: shoulders and back like a door, arms as thick as a normal man's thighs, a heavy, slow stride.
palette: deep bronze and heated-iron grey, scorched leather brown, storm blue, dull black
casual: His wall-post gear: a grey work smock issued by House Daixi with a weir pattern stitched on the back, over it a scorched leather apron burnt through in several places; three turns of iron chain wound round his waist with the clasps facing outward; on his back a huge smith's hammer whose head has a ring of blue lightning-scorch. His hands hang empty at his sides. He lowers his head a little, a slow, level look.
private: Resting at the forge at night: a sleeveless undyed linen shirt, the scorched leather apron, dark trousers, the three turns of chain still at his waist, the old burns on his bare arms showing. He sits holding a cooling iron bar in his big hands, turning it slowly, a quiet, absorbed look.
battle: Standing in front of a sluice-mouth gate: the grey smock buttoned across the chest, the scorched apron, the chain at his waist, heavy boots, bare bronze forearms. He grips the huge hammer in both hands, the head raised high, the blue scorch ring on it glowing faintly; braced at the very front, a hard, unmoving look.
formal: At a hearing in the city of grey rain: his cleanest grey House Daixi work smock with the weir pattern stitched large across the chest, an open folded collar, a broad belt of riveted leather, a plain dark wool cloak over one shoulder fastened by an iron clasp, the three turns of chain left at his waist. The scorch-ring brand on his neck shows above the open collar, faintly glowing blue. He stands stiff and upright with his big hands at his sides, a grave, awkward look.
art: A portrait from low and below with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale grey eyes lowered toward the viewer before they meet theirs, a slow, steady look; the chipped left horn sharp in the frame. Hard orange light from a forge on one side and a faint blue crackle on the hammer behind. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and ash. He wears the grey smock with the scorched apron.

name: 赫尔佳·施洛伊斯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:576
who: Helga Schleuse, a human sluice-keeper's daughter who leads a band of runaway families, twenty-three in 607: about 163 cm, not tall, thin and wiry, with narrow shoulders that fit through narrow ditches. Ink-blue hair cut to the earlobes, one lock always damp. A pale face from twelve years in a sluice-house without sun. Pale silver eyes that squint once in the dark and then see clearly. On the inside of her left wrist (on the viewer's right when she faces us) a thin blue line like a thread of water. The fingers are scored with cuts from ditches and gratings. A quick, sure-footed, quietly stubborn air.
build: 163 cm, thin and wiry: a B-cup, a narrow waist and narrow shoulders, light and quick.
palette: ink blue and wet slate, pale silver, oilcloth olive brown, tarnished brass
casual: Her ditch-runner's gear: an oilcloth coat with the cuffs tied tight and the hem cut short so it won't snag; a rope round her waist hung with a small tin lantern with a shuttered front, a short iron pry bar, and a bunch of her father's old sluice keys, rusted too far to open anything and still carried; boots with iron nails in the soles. She stands light on her feet with her weight forward, a quick, wary look.
private: Resting in a hidden room: a plain long-sleeved dark wool dress, a grey shawl, soft shoes, the damp blue lock of hair behind one ear. She holds a child's wet sock up to dry over a candle, a tired, gentle look.
battle: Breaking through a rusted grating in the dark: the oilcloth coat tied tight, the hood up, gloves with the fingers cut off, the nailed boots braced. She grips the short iron pry bar in both hands against a bar of the grating, the shuttered lantern hanging at her belt; a fierce, focused look.
formal: At a hearing before the families of the wall town: a clean dark blue wool jacket with a folded-down collar over a white linen shirt, sleeves cuffed back to the wrists, a short dark blue oilcloth cape over one shoulder, a single small iron key on a cord kept tucked at the chest, glowing a little with old sluice-rust light. A neat low knot of damp-dark hair. She stands very straight with her hands folded in front, a guarded, proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale silver eyes squinting once at the viewer and then opening wide, a quick, wary look. Almost no light, only a thin cool beam from one side catching her wet hair and the blue line on her wrist. Foreground blur: a rusted bar of a grating and drifting water drops. She wears the oilcloth coat.

name: 马克斯·奥兰
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:632
who: Max Oran, a human gate guard of the sluice-mouth wall town, twenty-one in 607: about 176 cm, medium height, broad-shouldered with thick arms, standing with his feet a half-step apart as if nailed to the ground. White-gold hair cropped very short; the tips of both ears were frostbitten and each keeps two scars. A round face with wind-red cheeks, and he purses his lips before he smiles. Amber eyes that never look away; the Oran family usually have them. A sturdy, steady, plain-spoken air.
build: 176 cm, broad-shouldered and sturdy: a thick neck, thick arms, a solid chest and legs.
palette: white gold and amber, old leather brown, wind red, wall grey, dull iron
casual: His gate-guard gear: old wall-issue leather armour with a left shoulder plate worn bright from standing in line, over a plain wool shirt with the collar open; a short spear in his right hand and a round shield on his left arm painted with the weir pattern of House Daixi; a cloth bag of bread at his belt. He stands with his feet apart, a steady, unflinching look.
private: Sitting on a bench in the kitchen hut: a plain undyed wool shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbow, dark trousers, the armour hung on a peg behind him. He holds half a loaf of bread in both hands and eats it very seriously, a content look.
battle: Holding the west gate: the old leather armour buckled tight, the bright left shoulder plate, leather bracers, a dented iron cap. He holds the round shield in front of his chest and the short spear low and ready behind it, his feet planted a half-step apart; a hard, level look.
formal: On duty at a parade of the wall town: the leather armour cleaned and oiled, a clean grey Daixi smock with the weir pattern over it, a plain dark cloak over the left shoulder, a polished belt. He stands at attention with the spear upright at his side, a serious, stiff look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the amber eyes looking straight at the viewer without looking away, the lips pressed together just before a smile. Cold wind-light from one side. Foreground blur: the edge of a worn round shield and a scatter of snow flakes. He wears the old leather armour with the bright left shoulder plate.

name: 巴斯蒂安·格洛克
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:839
who: Bastian Glock, a human mercenary rope-man of the lower quarter of a river city, twenty-eight: about 176 cm, medium height, thick-shouldered, with palms covered in hard rope calluses and an old scar across the web of the right hand from a rope that burned it when he was seventeen. Tangerine-orange hair left uncut all winter, down over his ears. Cobalt-blue eyes with dark shadows beneath them from nights without a whole night of sleep. A tired, listening, stubborn air: he crouches at wells and presses his ear to the stone.
build: 176 cm, thick-shouldered and wide-built: a broad back and heavy forearms from hauling rope, strong enough to haul an armoured man up on a line.
palette: tangerine orange and cobalt blue, faded canvas beige, rope hemp, dark leather brown
casual: His mercenary gear: a leather vest of the lower-quarter company over an old canvas coat with the collar open; on the left chest the company badge, a bell with seven lines beneath it, stitched crookedly by hand; a coil of hemp rope at his belt with a brass bell tied to the end of it. He stands with his head slightly tilted as if listening, a tired, steady look.
private: Sitting on the edge of a dock in the evening: a plain undyed linen shirt, sleeves rolled up, the vest off and hung beside him, dark trousers. He holds a mug of thin soup and dangles the brass bell on its rope from one finger, a drowsy, quiet look.
battle: Hauling on a rope at the mouth of a flooded dock: the leather vest buckled over the canvas coat, leather gloves, sturdy boots braced on wet stone. He grips the hemp rope in both hands, hauling, the brass bell at its end hanging beside him; a clenched-jaw, intent look.
formal: At the company's muster: an old canvas coat brushed clean with the collar open and folded back, a leather vest worn over it, the company badge neat on the left chest, a bell with seven lines beneath it stitched in faintly glowing thread, a short coil of hemp rope with its brass bell hung at the belt. He stands up straight with his hands behind his back, a tired, polite look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the cobalt-blue eyes with their dark circles looking straight at the viewer, an ear tilted as if he is listening for something far below. Cool grey dock light from one side, a lamp glow warm behind. Foreground blur: the end of a hemp rope with a brass bell and a drift of mist. He wears the canvas coat with the company badge.

name: 赫伯特·韦尔夫特
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:895
who: Herbert Welft, a human dock-keeper and boat-mender, seventy-one: about 178 cm, tall, thin and stooped, with knees that have been bad for twenty years so that he limps. Thin white hair, clean-shaven. The backs of his hands are covered in age spots and his fingertips are stained with tung oil and caulking fibre that never wash out. Pale blue eyes; he has looked at water all his life and looks at people the same way. A slow, dry, watchful air; he can tell by one look at a hull how many more launches it has in it.
face: FACE, as in the references: the face of a very old man, NOT young: long and lined, deep creases across the forehead and beside the mouth, hollow cheeks, pale blue eyes with heavy lids, thin white eyebrows, clean-shaven, a few age spots on the temples. Weathered pale skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: 178 cm, tall, thin and stooped: long bony arms, bad knees, careful on stairs.
palette: oilcloth olive and tarred brown, pale blue, white, tarnished iron and brass
casual: His dock-keeper's clothes: an oilcloth coat with the cuffs patched, a thick wool scarf, old dark trousers; on his belt a ring of keys, the biggest of them the key to the old sluice winch; held to his chest in both arms a dock register wrapped three times in oilcloth. He stands stooped, leaning a little on one hip, a dry, watchful look.
private: Sitting by a stove in the dock hut: a worn wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, a knitted cap, slippers, the oilcloth coat hung on the wall. He is rubbing tung oil into a splinter of wood with his stained thumb, a slow, quiet look.
battle: Working the old dock-gate winch: the oilcloth coat buttoned, the scarf, fingerless gloves, the key ring at his belt. He grips the long wooden lever of the winch in both hands, the whole stooped body leaning into it; a stubborn, set look; he carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the winch outfit: leaning with all his weight into the long wooden lever of a dock-gate winch, both hands gripping it, the stooped back straightened for the effort, a stubborn, set look; he carries no weapon.
formal: At the quay on the day of a launch: a clean dark oilcloth-lined wool coat with a wide turned collar worn open, a washed grey scarf, the big winch key polished and hung at his belt on a ring of old brass, a small brass tide charm on his lapel that glows a pale blue when water moves. He stands very upright with both hands on the head of a plain wooden stick, a grave, dry look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale blue eyes looking at the viewer as if at a hull, judging how many launches are left in it. Cool grey river light from one side. Foreground blur: a rope end soaked in tar and the rim of a tin of tung oil. He wears the oilcloth coat with the thick scarf.

name: 尤利乌斯·罗森塔尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:951
who: Julius Rosenthal, a human lecturer of the pattern institute and keeper of the furnace at the ring of towers, forty-one: about 183 cm, tall, thin and ramrod straight, the temples already white. Deep red hair combed straight back, not a hair out of place. A narrow face with a high nose and the corners of the mouth turned down. Gold eyes; he looks at a person's hands first, to see if there is a callus from drawing marks. On his own right middle finger a thick callus from holding charcoal. A cool, exact, impatient-with-fools air; he never runs.
build: 183 cm, tall and thin, ramrod straight: narrow shoulders a little curved forward from the desk, long hands, a slow, even stride.
palette: deep blue and copper red, gold, ink grey, parchment cream
casual: His institute lecturer's dress: a long deep blue robe with narrow sleeves buttoned to the collar, the collar pinned with the Rosenthal house brooch, a ring of engraved lines round a core; at his belt a leather case holding charcoal sticks, a fine pen, a roll of thin paper and a thick notebook. He carries no firearm. He stands very upright with his hands behind his back, a cool, appraising look.
private: Late at night in his study: a plain long-sleeved dark grey wool house coat, the collar open, the robe off over a chair, the red hair a little loosened. He holds a stick of charcoal and draws a tiny pattern on a scrap of paper while listening, a tired, absorbed look.
battle: Quelling a furnace: the deep blue robe belted tight, sleeves bound at the wrists, the brooch at the collar, leather gloves. He kneels on one knee and draws a line of glowing pattern on the stone floor with a stick of charcoal, the other hand held flat above it; he carries no firearm and no blade.
battle_pose: 3) the furnace-quelling outfit: kneeling on one knee on stone, drawing a glowing pattern line with a stick of charcoal, the other hand flat above it, a cold, absolutely focused look; he carries no firearm and no blade.
formal: At a hearing of the institute: the finest deep blue long robe, pressed, with the Rosenthal brooch at the collar and a narrow gold border at the cuffs, the red hair combed flat. He stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a severe, composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the gold eyes dropping to the viewer's hands first and then rising to their face, a severe, cool look. Pale blue daylight from a high window on one side, a faint copper glow of a furnace far behind. Foreground blur: a stick of charcoal and a thin line of copper-gold pattern light. He wears the deep blue robe with the brooch.

name: 薇丝塔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:1102
who: Vista, a human woman of the southern stone-feeding lands who became the captain of the White Raven company, twenty-three in 637 and drawn here as she is a few years later, after 641, in her mid-twenties: about 158 cm, not tall, with a very thick back and shoulders and thick arms, standing like a low wall. Glossy raven-black hair with a blue sheen, tied back loosely at her neck with a leather cord. A square face with heavy brows; violet eyes that look at a person's hands first, because she says hands do not lie. On the web of her left hand an old scar from prying a sealing-stone. A blunt, stubborn, restless air; she never says should, only I want and I will not.
build: 158 cm, short and powerfully built: a very thick back and shoulders, heavy arms, a solid C-cup, a thick waist and sturdy hips.
palette: raven black with a blue sheen, violet, worn leather brown, stone grey, dirty white
casual: Her company gear after 641: old worn leather armour with the sleeves mended, never replaced, over a plain wool shirt with the collar open; a coil of hemp rope and a small knife on her belt; on her back a rolled-up banner with a plain white raven stitched on it very crudely; in her right hand a narrow sword whose blade was re-forged from broken sealing stone, the guard and grip the original ones. She stands square, feet apart, a blunt, stubborn look.
private: Resting by the company's fire: the armour off, a plain undyed wool shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbow, dark trousers, the hair loosened from its cord, the rolled banner leaned against a rock beside her. She holds a bowl of stew in both hands and eats it like a wolf, a worn, easy look.
battle: Leading the company: the old leather armour buckled tight, leather bracers, the rope and knife at her belt, the white raven banner unrolled and tied across her back on a short pole. She grips the re-forged narrow sword in both hands, raised in front of her shoulder, braced on the front line; a fierce look, the heavy brows drawn together.
formal: Forced into a council tent and unhappy about it: the old leather armour wiped clean and oiled, the mended sleeves unchanged, a clean dark wool cloak pinned at one shoulder, the hair retied tight, the banner left rolled behind her. She stands stiffly with her arms folded and her weight on one hip, a sullen, wary look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the violet eyes dropping to the viewer's hands as if checking them before their face, a blunt, unsmiling look. Hard white morning light from one side over a grey stone slope. Foreground blur: the crude stitching of a white raven on a banner and a drift of stone dust. She wears the old leather armour with the mended sleeves.

name: 汉娜
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:1158
who: Hanna, a human girl who carries dinner to everyone in a stone-feeding village, fifteen: small and slight, about 152 cm, wholly covered by her clothes, her wrists thin and red scald marks on the backs of her hands. Honey-coloured hair in one thick braid, the tip tied with red thread. A face full of freckles and olive-green eyes; she tilts her head when she looks at someone. A bright, earnest, watchful air; she walks with a bowl of soup without spilling a drop.
palette: honey gold and olive green, faded wool brown, apron cream, a little red thread
casual: Her village clothes: a washed-out coarse wool dress with long sleeves, down to the shins, with a plain apron over it; in the apron pocket a candle stub and a flint; in both hands a clay bowl with a chip out of its rim, the one she carries food in. She stands holding the bowl level, her head tilted, a bright, earnest look.
private: By the fireside in the evening: a long-sleeved dark wool dress to the shins, a thick knitted shawl, thick wool stockings, the honey braid over one shoulder. She holds a mug of warm milk in both hands, a quiet, content look.
battle: Carrying food to the fighters in the dark: the long wool dress under a short thick wool jacket buttoned to the neck, a scarf, the apron, sturdy boots, the braid tucked into the collar. She holds the chipped clay bowl level in both hands with a cloth over it; a determined look.
battle_pose: 3) the carrying outfit: standing firm and determined, the shoulders squared, the feet planted, holding a covered clay bowl level in both hands in front of her; she does not fight.
formal: For a village feast: a clean long dark green wool dress with a white collar buttoned to the throat and long sleeves, a clean white apron, the braid freshly tied with a new red thread. She stands upright with the bowl held in front of her in both hands, a shy, serious look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face tilted slightly to one side, the olive-green eyes wide open and earnest, looking straight at the viewer, the mouth closed. She holds the chipped clay bowl near her chin in both hands, a thread of steam rising from it, warm firelight on one side of her face and cool blue dusk on the other. Foreground blur: the rim of the bowl and a few drifting sparks. She wears the washed wool dress with the apron.

name: 戈特哈德
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:1214
who: Gotthard, a human stone-sealer and smith of a stone-feeding village, sixty-three in 637: about 183 cm, tall, with a stooped back and big thick hands, the knuckles covered in chisel calluses, the top half of the little finger of his left hand missing. Short white hair and a short white beard, stone dust settled on the ears. His eyes are poor and he leans close to see; he clears his throat before he speaks, forty years of stone dust in the lungs. A slow, gruff, patient air; he can still swing a great hammer. The little finger of his left hand (the hand on the viewer's right when he faces us) ends at the middle joint, half its length missing, clearly drawn as a short stump whenever that hand is visible; in the panels where gloves cover it, the glove's little finger is visibly short and empty.
face: FACE, as in the references: the face of a very old man, NOT young: long and creased, deep lines across the forehead, a short white beard, narrowed pale grey-blue eyes that squint, stone dust in the eyebrows. Weathered pale skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 183 cm, tall and big-boned, stooped: a broad back gone round with years, huge hands and thick forearms.
palette: stone-dust grey and white, scorched leather brown, ember orange, linen
casual: His stone-sealer's clothes: a leather apron burnt through with holes over a plain wool shirt with the sleeves rolled; a row of chisels in a belt, a short-handled hammer, a charcoal stub tucked behind his ear; the right wrist wrapped in a strip of linen cloth, re-tied each spring in the same way. He stands stooped, squinting, a gruff, patient look.
private: Sitting on a bench outside his forge in the evening: the apron off, a worn wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, a flat cap, old slippers, the linen strip on his wrist. He holds a mug of thin beer, coughing once, a slow, content look.
battle: Sealing a stone: the leather apron, leather gloves, a cloth tied over his nose and mouth against the dust, a short hammer in his right hand and a broad chisel in his left. He holds the chisel against a stone block and raises the hammer to strike; a set, patient look.
formal: At the village rite of the sealing stone: a clean dark brown wool smock coat with a wide folded collar worn open over a white shirt, a stone-grey stole with sealing marks stitched along its edge that glow like faint embers, the apron off, the linen strip on his wrist fresh, hair and beard trimmed. He stands bent but upright with both hands on a short wooden mallet, a grave, gruff look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the squinting eyes leaning close toward the viewer as if to see them, a gruff, patient look. Warm ember light from a forge on one side and cool grey daylight on the other. Foreground blur: a chisel point and drifting stone dust in the light. He wears the burnt leather apron.

name: 卡尔恩·远望
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_三_白鸦的年月.md:1369
who: Karn Farsight, a beast-eared archer of the White Raven company, twenty-two: about 184 cm, tall, thin, with shoulder blades that show through his coat. Grey-brown animal ears on top of his head; the tip of his left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is missing a notch, frozen off in the winter of 644. He has no human ears at the sides of his head. Short ash-brown hair. Light amber eyes whose pupils narrow to thin slits in strong light. He always stands facing far away, even when eating. A quiet, absent, distant-looking air; he speaks while looking two miles behind you. The tip of his left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us) has a clearly visible V-shaped notch bitten out of the top edge, so that animal ear looks shorter and ragged; the other ear is whole. Show the notch in every panel and keep both ears visible.
build: 184 cm, tall and thin: narrow shoulders, long arms, a back leaning slightly forward, steady on a ridge all day.
palette: grey-brown and ash, light amber, old bow-wood brown, faded wool
casual: His archer's gear: an old grey-brown coat with the collar turned up against the wind, over a plain wool shirt; boots with the soles worn flat and nailed again; a quiver and a small leather pouch of dried meat on his belt. In his left hand a short bow of old wood handed down in a hunting band, its lacquer worn smooth. He stands facing the distance, the amber eyes narrowed, a quiet, absent look.
private: Resting on a ridge at dusk: the coat off over his knees, a plain wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, the quiver set beside him. He eats a strip of dried meat while standing, his eyes still on the far horizon, a calm, absent look.
battle: On a ridge before the shooting: the old coat buttoned with the collar up, a leather bracer on the left forearm, the quiver on his hip. He holds the short bow at full draw, the arrow aimed far out and slightly up, the amber eyes narrowed to slits; a still, focused look.
formal: At a company muster: the grey-brown coat brushed and buttoned, the collar up, the bow unstrung and carried in one hand, the ash-brown hair combed flat between the ears. He stands upright but looking past everyone, an absent, polite look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the face turned toward the viewer but the amber eyes looking over their shoulder at something two miles behind, the pupils narrowed to slits, the grey-brown ears raised. Hard white wind-light from one side. Foreground blur: the worn lacquered grip of a short bow and drifting flecks of snow. He wears the old coat with the collar turned up.
